thesis: The 26 Aug U.S. session traded a hotter-than-expected PCE print and pre-NVIDIA caution; NVIDIA's post-close results now shift the AI question from expectation to next-session price discovery, while Hong Kong remains a timestamped intraday observation until the official close and flow data arrive.

prior_thesis_audit.detail: BEA released the July Personal Income and Outlays report and Q2 GDP second estimate at 08:30 EDT on 26 Aug.
NVIDIA released FY27 Q2 results after the 26 Aug U.S. close; the prior pending boundary is resolved.
26 Aug completed Hong Kong turnover and Stock Connect data were not independently captured in this run and are not inferred.

this_week.when: 27 Aug 2026 U.S. regular session / 21:30 HKT open
this_week.boundary: Results are completed; regular-session reaction remains a future market test at this HKT cutoff.
this_week.positive: Price action holds after the open while investors continue to distinguish formal Q3 guidance, data-center revenue and execution evidence.
this_week.negative: A reversal or broad AI-hardware weakness despite the release highlights valuation, margin, supply or financing concerns.

this_week.event: Hong Kong completed close, turnover and Stock Connect confirmation
this_week.boundary: The 14:04 HKT index snapshot is not a close; turnover and southbound data remain pending.
this_week.positive: Completed HSTECH / HSCEI performance and verified flow data align with the intraday direction.
this_week.negative: The intraday snapshot fades by the close or lacks turnover / flow confirmation.

this_week.event: Chairman Kevin Warsh keynote at Jackson Hole
this_week.boundary: Officially scheduled by the Kansas City Fed and the Federal Reserve; no speech outcome is known.
this_week.positive: Communication reduces uncertainty around inflation, policy and long-duration risk premia without weakening growth evidence.
this_week.negative: Communication renews inflation, policy or duration pressure that challenges high-valuation technology multiples.
